title: Card 2: topic ke tukde (partition), ek tukda ek worker. 10 x 500 = 5,000. Worker tukdon se zyada = khaali

callouts.red: Ek hi line me aur worker laga dete?
callouts.green: Bekaar: ek line ko ek hi worker padh sakta, baaki worker khaali baithe rehte

callouts.red: Worker badhaye, phir bhi line lambi hoti ja rahi
callouts.green: Pehle dekho tukde kitne hain. Tukde 10 hain to 11va worker kuch nahi karega, pehle tukde badhao

callouts.red: Kitne tukde rakhein? Jitne worker ek saath chahiye: 5,000 / sec ÷ 500 ek worker = 10. Shuru me thoda zyada rakho, baad me badhaoge to key ka tukda badal jaata.
callouts.green: 12 worker aur 10 tukde? 2 worker khaali baithe rahenge

kyun: Topic ke tukde (partition) bana do. Ek tukde ko ek hi worker padhta, to 10 tukde = 10 worker ek saath. Bheed badhe to tukde badhao
peeche: card 1 me LOG disk pe + OFFSET
ab: 10 baje sale, 5,000 / sec, ek worker 500 hi. Arpan ka order line me atka
agla: ab tukde ho gaye, par Arpan ki khabar kram me rahegi? (card 3)
